## 2024-05-24 - Fix XSS vulnerability in QR Code rendering
**Vulnerability:** XSS vulnerability via dangerouslySetInnerHTML and qrcode-generator's createSvgTag
**Learning:** Using createSvgTag with dangerouslySetInnerHTML in React introduces an XSS risk. qrcode-generator provides createDataURL which is safer.
**Prevention:** Use createDataURL and standard <img> tags for rendering QR codes generated by qrcode-generator in React.
